name: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd
title: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd - 534091 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Exchange volumes ran hot in FY26 (ADT ~2.5x, revenue more than doubled to INR2,302 crores), but management gave no numeric guidance, declined April-May participation data and flagged cyclicality and rising expenses.

triggers.label: FY26 ADT ~2.5x, revenue doubled
triggers.quote: supported by nearly 2.5 times increase in the average daily turnover across both futures and options

triggers.label: Equity exchange entering commodities
triggers.quote: as equity Exchanges enter into the commodity space, there could be some natural sort of synergies they have there

red_flags.label: Rising expenses outpacing revenue; no margin expansion
red_flags.quote: the product license fees and other expenses line items grew faster than the revenue

red_flags.label: Competitor launching bullion/energy products and expiry changes
red_flags.quote: Some recent activity on changing expiry dates and so on, in the energy segment is leading to some kind of shallow, 1-day-in-a-month activity

red_flags.label: RBI lending norms may hit member credit lines
red_flags.quote: there will be a certain segment of members, across all segments of the trading markets who will have some of their credit lines impacted from this

evasions.quote: I don't think we are commenting on this quarter
I think we will be unable to really comment or really react to that question
the focus is not going to be on spending less
